review.verbatim_critique: [D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The note proves the advertised matched pointwise mean-absolute-risk rate on the exact known-uniform, bounded-overlap Bernoulli class, including a fixed-n same-class converse and a total estimator; no conjecture or one-sided surrogate remains in the headline theorem. Its contribution is nevertheless confined to resolving the converse on a strict, highly structured subclass for which the corresponding upper-rate phenomenon was already published, so it does not establish a new general CATE frontier. The practical interpretation is only a precision benchmark: the paper supplies neither adaptation nor inference nor evidence that the cited forest and R-learner workflows attain the rate. These scope and significance constraints keep the projected leading-econometrics-journal score below the stronger broad minimax papers in the calibration set. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.9 < 7.2, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
